important_evidence: PCSPred: Random Forest classifier for short-chain AMPs, trained on physico-chemical features; no code or dataset available (abstract only).
iAMPCN: Existing deep learning framework applied to marine AMP discovery; GitHub repository available at https://github.com/joy50706/iAMPCN.
Anti-aging peptide predictor AAGP is not an AMP model but appears in the same batch; its GitHub repository is https://github.com/saptawtf/AAGP.
uncertainties: PCSPred full text unavailable; code and dataset details unknown.
iAMPCN original model publication not identified; the article uses the model but does not provide training dataset details.
AAGP and PepLab papers are not AMP prediction models, but they contain related datasets (anti-aging peptides, multi-class bioactive peptides).
